prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one 4:3 landscape painting for The Burnt Book Sanskrit learning story. Request 1536 x 1152 native output or the closest supported native 4:3 resolution. Refined Indian watercolor with restrained gouache on warm ivory paper; organic detail, quiet ochre, sage, dusty terracotta, muted indigo. Warm, gentle, evocative storytelling, consistent character design.
Canonical scene brief: The young man at a shady crossroads outside the town with a water pot and a basket of roasted chickpeas, giving them to tired woodcutters who rest under a tree with bundles of logs beside them; late afternoon light.
Character appearances:

Phone-first composition: clear compact narrative grouping, essential faces, hands and objects comfortably inside all edges. Show the complete scene without border. No collage or multi-panel layout.
Writing is permitted by the owner. This particular scene needs no readable inscription; focus on its narrative. Do not invent scripts or fill small objects with pseudo-lettering. No watermark or UI.

sources.title: Kathāsaritsāgara 1.6.53–97 (Digital Corpus of Sanskrit), the story retold in new, simple sentences
sources.note: The plot follows Somadeva's text: a poor young man, a dead mouse, roasted chickpeas, woodcutters, a shop, a golden mouse. The Sanskrit here is new, in the present tense.

image.brief: A poor young man in a patched kurta standing before a richly dressed merchant in a market lane; the merchant looking down at a small dead mouse on the ground and laughing, the young man pointing at it with a thoughtful look; warm old-India watercolour.

alt.en: A poor young man and a laughing merchant looking at a dead mouse
alt.hi: ग़रीब युवक और मरे चूहे को देखकर हँसता व्यापारी

meaning.en: A poor young man sees a merchant.
meaning.hi: एक ग़रीब युवक एक व्यापारी को देखता है।

meaning.en: The merchant sees a dead mouse.
meaning.hi: व्यापारी एक मरा हुआ चूहा देखता है।

meaning.en: The young man says: “I take the mouse.”
meaning.hi: युवक कहता है: “मैं चूहा लेता हूँ।”

meaning.en: The young man takes the mouse.

image.brief: The young man at a shady crossroads outside the town with a water pot and a basket of roasted chickpeas, giving them to tired woodcutters who rest under a tree with bundles of logs beside them; late afternoon light.

alt.en: A young man shares water and chickpeas with tired woodcutters at a crossroads
alt.hi: चौराहे पर थके लकड़हारों को पानी और चने देता युवक

meaning.hi: वह चूहे को ले जाता है।

meaning.en: The young man stands at the crossroads.
meaning.hi: युवक चौराहे पर खड़ा होता है।

image.brief: The young man in good clothes standing proudly at the door of his own busy shop, holding up a small golden mouse; the old merchant Viśākhila smiling beside his daughter who is garlanding him; neighbours cheering.

alt.en: A prosperous young man holds up a golden mouse beside a smiling merchant and his daughter
alt.hi: सुनहरा चूहा थामे धनी युवक, पास में मुस्कुराता व्यापारी और उसकी कन्या

meaning.en: The young man takes the logs to the market.
meaning.hi: युवक लकड़ियाँ बाज़ार ले जाता है।

meaning.en: The young man takes much money.
The young man opens a shop.

meaning.hi: वह एक सुनहरा चूहा बनाता है।
